title: Offline durable journal, checkpoint, and fenced recovery contract

rules: append is accepted only for the current task, project, worktree, session, worker, lease, and fence
a committed append has a contiguous sequence and previous-record digest
a checkpoint is immutable and references the committed journal head and state/input/result digests
an exact operation replay returns the original committed result; changed replay is rejected
a crash after append before fsync creates an ambiguous operation and fences the old worker permanently
recovery requires a durable checkpoint, a newer worker and lease, and a new fencing token
resume replays only the exact checkpoint and cannot manufacture completion or authority decisions
ambiguous operations are never guessed, retried, or marked successful

durability.format: canonical UTF-8 JSON records with a SHA-256 hash chain
durability.commit: prepare a complete record, flush/fsync, then expose it as committed
durability.recovery: discard no uncertain operation silently; preserve ambiguity as blocked and fail closed
durability.replay: single-use operation IDs; byte-identical input returns the original result
durability.checkpoint: immutable committed record, bound to the journal head and fencing token

privacy.projection: opaque identifiers, bounded enums, counters, and SHA-256 digests only

compatibility.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline
compatibility.minor_change: new version with a new checker and fixture

failure_semantics.external_effects: none: no network, provider, LLM, Coordinator, Git, hosted CI, UI, or durable state mutation

evidence_boundary.offline: deterministic model, fixture, checker, and local unit tests only
evidence_boundary.live: unverified; real fsync, locking, crash injection, process recovery, and Coordinator integration require a separately approved AR
follow_up: Integrate the model with project-bound Coordinator lease and durable state APIs after independent AWQ/AWG/security review.
Add platform-specific atomic replace, fsync-directory, lock, and power-loss qualification without weakening ambiguity handling.
